resources.string: Choose a group, review the settings, then tap Apply. Presets run only when you tap. Settings stay changed until you change them again.
Options are based on your AirPods model. Firmware may not accept or report every change. Omitted settings stay unchanged.
Connect your selected AirPods to apply a preset. Demo mode does not send changes.
No scene presets are available for this model.
The connection changed. These results belong to the previous connection and do not describe the current AirPods.
A new AirPods report matched the requested value after sending.
The command was not sent. Try applying again.
Sending did not finish successfully. The device may still have received part or all of the command.
No matching device report arrived in time. This firmware may not report this setting.
The connection or selected device changed before this setting could be confirmed.
Another manual change replaced this setting.
This setting is no longer available or unlocked.
An earlier request is unresolved. A delayed report cannot confirm this retry; reconnect before trying again.
Target value observed describes a device report, not an acknowledgement of a specific command. Unconfirmed settings may still have changed. Presets can apply partly; changes are not rolled back.
